testcase.name: Given a selected country, when I update it, then I expect the state to reflect it
Given unknown phone lookup, when I click next, then I expect NotFound
Given username mode, when I change user entry, then I expect unaltered value
Given empty country filter, when I filter countries, then I expect empty countries list
Given matching country code, when I filter countries, then I expect matched countries
Given username fetch network error, when I click next, then I expect NetworkError
Given empty phone number, when I click next, then I expect InvalidEntry
Given matching country name, when I filter countries, then I expect matched countries
Given valid username, when I click next, then I expect Success
Given username not found, when I click next, then I expect NotFound
Given phone number mode, when I change user entry, then I expect digits only
Given invalid username, when I click next, then I expect InvalidEntry
Given valid phone lookup, when I click next, then I expect Success
